messages:
deploy-bot: INITIATING CONFIG-ONLY rollout -> CANARY (splitflow routing). change-window=2026-04-02T01:00Z..2026-04-02T02:00Z. brief: tighten batching window + small timeout adjust. release-notes draft: https://go/relnotes/splitflow-tune 

carmen: dropping config snippet here for visibility:
```
routing:
  mode: splitflow
  weights: { canary: 0.12, stable: 0.88 }
batching:
  batch_size: 12
  window_ms: 40
  concurrency_limit: 20
timeouts:
  req_timeout_ms: 2200
  kv_cache_ttl_ms: 45000
limits:
  min_tenant_qps: 0.03
```

noah: tagging @sre. I'll watch p99, p95, and cache hit-rate. putting a short watchlist: p99>750ms or errors>0.7% -> paged.

igor: can we predefine an automated soft-fallback to a lower-memory model if tail gets bad? propose `fallback: v3-lite-quant` with automatic shift of 100% for canary if p99>900ms for 90s.

sre-bot: noted: runbook link -> https://go/runbooks/autofallback. will trigger incident on fallback shift.

deploy-bot: applied config to pool: canary-silver (id: pool-7b). initial rollout 12% to canary-silver. health checks started.

carmen: quick smoke using tenant test-suite: `python infra/tests/smoke_regen.py --model=service-default --count=8` -> all 8 OK, median latency ~82ms.

kevin: watching dashboards. creating temporary alert: canary.p95 > 400ms OR canary.errors > 0.5% -> slack #eng-oncall notify.

noah: initial metrics after 10m: p50=60ms p95=150ms p99=430ms. kv cache hit 78%. looks healthy.

igor: request: reduce batch_size to 9 to lower tail for multi-tenant noisy workloads. keep window_ms=40.

carmen: +1. smaller batches usually help tail on our mix.

deploy-bot: updating canary config: `batching.batch_size=9` applied. rebalancing.

kevin: small spike at 01:12 — alert fired then auto-resolved. looks like a single tenant burst. no action.

noah: ran targeted throughput test against canary-silver tenants. CPU and memory stable. latency improved ~5-8% at p99.

sre-bot: auto-fallback policy not yet enabled. need explicit ACK to arm. who wants to enable?

carmen: arm autofallback now with threshold p99>900ms for 90s. ensure it posts to #incidents.

deploy-bot: autofallback armed: `if p99_ms(canary) > 900 for 90s -> route_canary=100% fallback=v3-lite-quant; notify=#incidents`.

noah: attempt to increase canary to 30% blocked by pool quota guard (quota_limit_exceeded). reverting to 12%.

kevin: i'm on it 1: adjusting quota guard to allow 30% for 20 minutes, then will revert.

kevin: quota guard bumped. trying 30%.

deploy-bot: updated weights: { canary: 0.30, stable: 0.70 }. running 5m health window.

noah: 5m in at 30% -> p99=420ms, errors steady, cache hit 76%. no regressions in logs.

igor: ran a cross-tenant regen load; tail improved vs baseline. looks safe to proceed to global roll after post-check.

carmen: hold for 15m stable at 30% then promote. adding note to release notes draft: "batch_size reduced to 9, request timeout trimmed to 2200ms, autofallback policy armed to v3-lite-quant."

kevin: revert scheduled for 02:20Z to drop quota guard back.

deploy-bot: at 01:45 change-window end approaching. initiating final validation.

noah: final smoke (20 prompts) OK. matching quality thresholds. latency stable.

carmen: promoting. will remove splitflow once propagation completes. leaving calendar reminder to unpin routing override in 36h if stable.

sre-bot: reminder created: unpin-check 2026-04-04T13:00Z.

deploy-bot: CONFIG-ONLY rollout COMPLETE: splitflow removed; updated batching/timeouts/limits applied cluster-wide. links: config-diff: https://go/config/diff/1789991110 ; metrics-snapshot: https://go/metrics/snap/1789991110 

igor: no rollback needed. nice incremental run. :thumbsup: 

kevin: reverting quota guard now as planned.

carmen: publishing short release note and changelog entry. will ping #product-release. closing thread.
